findings.title: The feature-flagged table path discards all table results
findings.body: When `use-table-widget-visualization` is enabled, this branch constructs `TableWidgetVisualization` with `columns={[]}` and an empty `tableData`, rather than passing the current `result.data` and metadata. Consequently, dashboard table widgets render blank for organizations with this feature enabled, even when their queries return data.

findings.title: Error details can be paired with the wrong replay error ID
findings.body: `get_multi` returns a mapping, but this code pairs `error_ids` with `events.values()` by position. Mapping value order is not a reliable association with the requested IDs, and missing nodestore entries can also shift the pairing. The endpoint can therefore attach one event's title, message, and timestamp to another error ID, producing incorrect replay summaries.

findings.title: Every paginated segment page receives all replay errors
findings.body: The paginator calls `analyze_recording_segments` for each page of segment metadata, but the same full `error_events` list is bound into every call here. `get_request_data` then appends any errors not encountered before the page's breadcrumbs, including errors outside that page's time range. Paginated responses can repeat unrelated errors and send incorrect context to the summarizer.

findings.title: Age and timestamp can coexist when either is zero
findings.body: The mutual-exclusion check uses truthiness rather than checking whether the other field was supplied. Thus a report containing both `age: 1` and `timestamp: 0` passes `validate_age`, and one containing `age: 0` and a nonzero timestamp passes `validate_timestamp`. This accepts report objects that violate the supported format contract.
